title: Customer escalation: SLOs & prefetch realignment for mixed-model latency regression
creator: Evelyn Chen
description: Production regression observed across Hosted, Dedicated and Private clusters: a sustained TTFT increase (+120-400ms) and tokens/sec drop for several customers after a staged quantized-kernel rollout. Root cause analysis points to a timing interaction between the new dynamic kernel selector (hot path for int8 quant variants) and the KV prefetch heuristic: under medium fanout patterns the selector occasionally chooses a suboptimal kernel that delays KV warmup, causing priming oscillations and token throughput collapse. This ticket tracks an emergency mitigation (ingress rate-cap + short TTL prefetch realignment) and a safe rollback path for affected model variants. Goals: restore customer SLOs within 24h, deploy a canary with realigned prefetch heuristic and a short-lived ingress token rate cap, validate regression removal with per-tenant replay and production shadowing, and schedule a follow-up hard fix (kernel selector guardrails) for runtime-1.37.
